title: Minecraft Finite
description: Data pack that changes minecraft terrain gen to be bigger and have more drastic features
body:
Minecraft Finite is a datapack that has the same world generation changes as my [Minecraft Infinity](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-infinity-(terrain-gen))  mod, but this data pack doesnt add any modded biomes.

**THIS PROJECT IS NO LONGER RECEIVING UPDATES, PLEASE GO [HERE](https://modrinth.com/mod/for-the-love-of-updates)**
